title: Blood Red Lotus
art_style: High-contrast, chiaroscuro noir; moody lighting with blood-red accents
short_summary: In the rain-soaked, neon-lit city of New Harbor, private detective Jack Malone is drawn into a murder mystery involving his old informant Eddie Chen. Navigating corrupt cops, a haunted past, and dangerous allegiances, Jack must uncover the truth behind Eddie's death. Amid betrayals and shadowy deals, justice is elusive, and redemption is hard-won in the city's blood red glow.
world_context: New Harbor City in the 1950s is a sprawling urban nightmare of neon and fog, where loyalty is scarce and danger lurks in every shadow. The culture, corrupt officials, and analog forensics shape a tense environment where trust is a liability and every ally may hide a knife.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Rugged Irish-American man in his late 40s, weathered face with stubble, sharp gray eyes, limping gait due to a ruined knee
quirks: Always rubs a silver dollar in his palm when thinking
Smokes half-cigarettes, often lit but half-burned
Wears a battered trench coat and fedora
characters.typical_attire: Worn trench coat, loosened tie, slacks, and scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Ex-cop turned private investigator, haunted by past betrayals and a ruined knee from a violent case. Cynical but driven by a personal code of justice.
characters.motivations: Seeking redemption and truth in a corrupt city, haunted by ghosts of his past and the loss of trust.

characters.name: Veronica Steele
characters.physical_traits: Sultry woman in early 30s, emerald green eyes, dark hair styled in soft waves, slender dancer's frame
quirks: Often wears a green dress that clings to her figure
Her fingers tremble slightly when nervous
characters.typical_attire: Elegant dresses, often in dark or jewel tones
characters.backstory: Club owner with a mysterious past, caught between survival and secrets. Sister to missing Eddie Chen.
characters.motivations: Desperate to find her brother and protect her club, balancing loyalty and danger.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack Malone receives a call from Veronica Steele about her missing brother Eddie. Haunted by his past and the city's corruption, Jack prepares to investigate, stepping into the rain-soaked streets outside the Black Lotus club.

scenes.scene_description: Jack sits in his dimly lit office, rain pattering on the window. He receives a call from Veronica Steele about her missing brother.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Establishing shot of Jack Malone's cramped, cluttered office at night. Rain streaks the window behind him, neon from the Black Lotus sign casting a red glow through the fog. Jack sits behind a battered wooden desk, his ruined knee visible as he rubs a silver dollar in his palm. The air is thick with cigarette smoke and stale whiskey bottles. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack sits at his desk, lost in thought, rain pattering outside.

dialogue.text: The city never sleeps, only shivers.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues with harsh red accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Close-up of Jack's hand rubbing a worn silver dollar, thumb tracing its edge. The desk is cluttered with old case files, a half-empty glass of whiskey, and a lit half-cigarette with smoke curling upward. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack rubs the silver dollar thoughtfully.
panels.color_palette: muted browns and grays with red highlights

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Medium shot of Jack picking up a rotary phone, his face shadowed but eyes sharp. The neon sign outside flickers red through the rain-streaked window behind him. Portrait 4:5.

pages.page_description: Establishing Jack's office atmosphere and the phone call arrival.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Close-up of Jack's face, eyes narrowed, lips parted as he listens intently to the phone. Smoke from his cigarette curls around his head. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack listens to Veronica Steele's voice on the phone.

dialogue.text: Jack, it's Eddie. He's missing. Not just late. Gone.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Wide shot of Jack's office, showing the cluttered desk, the glowing neon sign outside, and Jack's silhouette reflected in the rain-streaked window. The room is dim, lit only by the neon and a desk lamp. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack hangs up the phone, deep in thought.

dialogue.text: The city bled blue and red on rain-slicked streets. His own reflection, a ruined ghost.

pages.page_description: Jack receives Veronica's call and contemplates the missing brother.

scenes.location: Jack Malone's Office to Street Outside Black Lotus
scenes.scene_description: Jack prepares to leave his office, slipping his notebook into his coat and limping down the stairs into the rain-soaked city streets outside the Black Lotus club.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Medium shot of Jack slipping a worn notebook into the inside pocket of his trench coat. The office is dim, rain visible through the window. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack prepares to leave, securing his notebook.
panels.color_palette: muted blues and grays with red highlights

panels.location: Stairwell of Jack Malone's Office Building
panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Wide shot from below showing Jack limping down a narrow, dimly lit stairwell. Shadows stretch long, rain sound faint in the background. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack descends the stairs, his limp evident.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Wide shot of Jack standing under a streetlamp outside the Black Lotus club. Rain falls heavily, neon sign flickers red and blue through the fog. Jack lights a half-cigarette, smoke curling in the amber glow. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack pauses outside the club, watching shadows behind rain-streaked glass.

dialogue.text: The city assaulted him: the acidic tang of wet garbage, the distant moan of a saxophone, the chill biting through his coat.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues with red neon highlights

pages.page_description: Jack leaves his office and steps into the rain outside the Black Lotus.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Close-up of Jack's face, eyes narrowed, smoke from his cigarette blending with the fog. Neon red light reflects off his weathered skin. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack contemplates the shadows behind the club's rain-streaked glass.

dialogue.text: Memory and suspicion kept him company.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir style. Medium shot of the Black Lotus club's neon sign flickering through the rain and fog. Shadows move behind the glass, indistinct figures blurred by the wet surface. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Shadows move behind rain-streaked glass of the club.

pages.page_description: Jack watches the club, pondering what ghosts await inside.
